# Campus Bite

Thank you for downloading Campus Bite.

## What's new in this release

- Removed the automatic striking engine.
- Now one can order meals without worrying about being banned for missing their food.

## APKs

### UNIVERSAL
Works on almost any android device but large size.

### ARM64-v8a
Recommended for almost all Android devices.

### ARMv7
For older Android phones.

### x86_64
For emulators and Intel devices.
